issues.description: The final 14 cell type labels are described slightly differently in Results ('α, proliferating α, β, δ, γ, ε, acinar, ductal, stellate/activated stellate, endothelial, Schwann, mast, immune') versus Methods annotation list ('beta, alpha, delta, gamma, epsilon, ductal, acinar, stellate, activated stellate, endothelial, Schwann, immune, mast, proliferating cells'). Both yield 14 labels but with different naming, which may reflect proliferating α being annotated as proliferating cells.

Candidates 5 (REG1A) and 6 (PRSS2) are called exocrine markers only in the SoupX ambient RNA contamination QC section; they were not used for cell type annotation and are therefore judged context_only.
Candidates 7-11 (ABCC8, G6PC2, PDX1, SLC30A8, RBP4) are described as elevated expression of genes enriched in the insulin secretion pathway for β-cell cluster 1, not as markers; judged context_only.
New subpopulation markers CFAP126, CD63, CDKN2A, CDKN2B, PLK2, and B2M were found in the Results text/figure context and added as new findings.

DDIT3, HSPA5, HERPUD1, and TRIB3 are mentioned as previously documented ER-stress markers, but only as post hoc validation/description (Supplementary Figure 10d), not as markers used for cluster annotation; therefore not added.

The candidate list contains duplicate gene-cell type pairs (INS/β at indices 0 and 12; GCG/α at 1 and 13; SST/δ at 2 and 14; PPY/γ at 3 and 15; GHRL/ε at 4 and 16). Both instances were retained as separate verifications because evidence locations differ.
